remarks: Welcome to this light-filled, beautifully updated condo in the heart of downtown Stamford. Freshly painted throughout, this residence features a crisp white kitchen with quartz countertops and updated stainless steel appliances, offering a modern and functional space for everyday living. The oversized bedroom is complemented by a full bath and a generous custom walk-in closet. Enjoy sweeping city views and stunning sunset vistas from this high-floor unit. The building offers exceptional amenities including 24-hour concierge service, a state-of-the-art fitness center, community room, expansive outdoor courtyard, dog park, and a convenient shuttle to Metro-North-making it ideal for commuters. Indoor garage parking is available for $106/month, along with a private storage unit located on the third floor. Pet-friendly and perfectly situated just steps from downtown dining, shopping, and entertainment.
